product.name: Asus 65W Small Pin Charger
product.full_name: Replacement 65W Charger for Asus ExpertBook / PU Series / VivoBook OLED
product.description: Replacement power adapter (Model ADP-65DW A, Part No. PA-1650-78, EXA1203YH, EXA1203XH) for Asus PU550, PU550CA, PU401, PU401LA, BU401LA, BU401LG, B551LA, B551LG, BU400A, BU400VC, B400A, BU201LA, ASUS Pro B8430UA, ASUS Pro P2710, P2710JA, P751JA, P751JF, ProART450CD, ProART450VB, PU500, PU500CA, X755, X755JA, Q524UQ, Q534UX, P2540UA, and P2540UV. Also fits the newer VivoBook 15 OLED X1505 Series. 19V, 3.42A, 65W output through the 4.5mm x 3.0mm barrel connector with center pin — note this is a different, thicker connector than the standard Asus 65W VivoBook/ZenBook charger (4.0mm x 1.35mm, no center pin). Wide-range 100–240V AC input for worldwide use. Tested before dispatch, drop-in replacement for the original charger.

faqs.question: How do I know this charger fits my laptop?
faqs.answer: Each listing shows the wattage and connector type. If you're unsure, send us a photo of your original charger or your laptop model on WhatsApp and we'll confirm before you order.

faqs.question: Is a higher-wattage charger safe to use?
faqs.answer: Yes — a charger rated higher than your laptop's original wattage is safe; your laptop only draws what it needs. A lower-wattage charger should be avoided.
